newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa gasoline prices steady, diesel down.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa gasoline prices steady, diesel down.

text.p: South Africa's Central Energy Fund said gasoline prices would remain unchanged and diesel would fall by nine cents with effect from August 6.
Illuminating paraffin would also be kept steady.

The Central Energy Fund said that during the period under review the international price of gasoline, diesel and illuminating paraffin had decreased, but that the impact on the average price of gasoline and paraffin has been minimal.
It said that the rand had weakened against the U.S. dollar during the period to around 4.5462 compared with 4.4910 in the previous period.
The price of 93 octane gasoline in the Gauteng area around Johannesburg will remain at 214 cents. At the coast the price stays at 203 cents.
The price of diesel in Gauteng will be 193 cents and 182 cents on the coast, while illuminating paraffin stays at 119.73 cents in Gauteng and 106.43 at the coast.
